name: Payment
description: Invoice timing, late fees, and acceptable payment windows.

name: Termination
description: Conditions and notice periods under which either party can end the agreement.

name: Confidentiality
description: How each party must protect the other's confidential information.

name: Limitation of Liability
description: Caps on damages and exclusions of certain types of losses.

name: Automatic Renewal
description: Whether the agreement auto-renews and what notice is required to prevent it.

name: Data Protection
description: Security obligations and breach notification timelines.

name: Intellectual Property
description: Ownership of work product, deliverables, and pre-existing materials.
